title: After the Satsuki Sho: Flying with the Wind

text_block_list.name: Commentator
text_block_list.text: Goal in! Winner of Satsuki Sho is —
(Waaaaaaaーーーーー!)

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan A
text_block_list.text:
Stay Gold ran so well～! Does this mean 
we'll be seeing her at the Japan Derby?

text_block_list.name: Racing Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Well, I have to say, this race was mostly 
about speed, not sure how she'd do once 
the distance is increased.

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text: …As expected, this is seriously great ——

text_block_list.name: Bubble Gum Fellow
text_block_list.text:
That you could fulfill someone's dreams 
just from running alone.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
You're right… Watching Stego run makes me 
feel oddly excited. If she can foster the 
power she grasps ——

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I must say, as an entertainer, I'm feeling 
just a tad little jealous.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Yayayaaa～! Stego and Bright both ran absolutely wonderfully today! Isn't that right, Suzuka!

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text: Yes…… Indeed……

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text:
Passion! Luck! I can feel it all welling 
throughout! At the Japan Derby, shall we 
all ——

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: mee… Suzuka? Is everything alright?

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
…I'm extremely sorry, Fukukitaru. I… I am 
going to head off for a run.

text_block_list.name: Matikanefukukitaru
text_block_list.text: Eh? Ah, wait? Suuuzuuukaaa?
(Waaaaaaーーーーーー!)

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: The wind… something's changed…

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text: Stayyyy Goldddd!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan C
text_block_list.text:
You were so cool! Do your best from now 
on!

text_block_list.name: Race Fan D
text_block_list.text:
I'm looking forward to the Japan Derby! 
I'll be rooting for you!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hahah——

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
…To think I'd be able to bask in this 
atmosphere from so early on.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
(Truly, this is a path unbeknownst to 
anyone… isn't it)
(Waaaaaaーーーーーー!)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text: ……What, may this be?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Miss Stego's running, it is as if she 
reached her full speed… I… what should I…

I waited to greet the Stay Gold who ran 
tremendously well at the Satsuki Sho 
today. Her expression was that of maximum 
satisfaction…!
choice_data_list: That was the greatest Satsuki Sho ever…!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
That's right. It was the greatest feeling 
ever for me as well.

Your performance today was brilliant today 
and with this, you have successfully made 
it into the Japan Derby.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for your hard work, desu wa… You 
have done a wonderful job.

text_block_list.name: $(scale 55)Elegant Chestnut-Haired Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Miss Stego, you ran absolutely splendidly 
today…! My chest was burning with each 
stride you took…!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Hahahah. Did I run so well to bring tears to your eyes? Though, I think it's still too early for that.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Because we've only beaten the first of the 
Classics. You'll have to keep watching 
from now on, alright?

text_block_list.name: $(scale 55)Elegant Chestnut-Haired Horsegirl
text_block_list.text:
Yes…! All my anticipation is brimming for 
the Japan Derby…!

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: That's the way.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
——Now then, Trainer. Let's have even more 
fun with the next one.

With this, Stay Gold has successfully won 
her first battle with the Classics —
——That night.

Now that we're facing the Japan Derby, I'm 
reflecting on today's performance at the 
Satsuki Sho.

It was apparent that Mejiro Bright was the 
one expected to win.

Sharing an incredibly strong connection, 
Stay Gold named her as one of the 'Ones 
Who Shine', which is why I also found 
myself feeling cautious about this race, 
but —

She was certainly strong, yet I couldn't 
deny that there were other horse girls who 
emitted a far more oppressive aura than 
Bright could…

Ending on that note, just as I was about 
to start adjusting our strategies for the 
upcoming Japan Derby —

I was able to hear its sound floating 
gently through the night. Guided by the 
tune, I exited the trainer's suite and —

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
…Thought I'd take a break and go for a 
walk.
choice_data_list: …I thought I heard you in the distance

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Haha, that means your ears work pretty well.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
You tend to show up like this because you 
want to tell me about something you 
noticed on our travels. I'll hear you out.

…With that answer, I started to unpack my 
thoughts on Mejiro Bright's performance 
today and —

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
…I see. Though, that's all it really is, 
isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Bright in the other world glimmered with a 
power that could carry her on for 
thousands of miles.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I'm sure she's on her way to finding that 
power… like a flower bud hoping to bloom.
choice_data_list: So her glimmer has yet to shine…
So her glimmer has yet to shine…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Even so, this is all just a hunch from my 
"memories"……Because this journey of ours 
goes down a completely different path.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
I felt it today… When I was running in the 
Satsuki Sho.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
The doors to a completely new world opened 
up to us, and each step will only expand 
it further…

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
To Bright and the other guys, I have no 
idea what the future holds for them.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text:
Of course, that includes me as well… But 
——
choice_data_list: …Let's both look forward to all of this.

text_block_list.name: Stay Gold
text_block_list.text: Exactly.

The night breeze caressed our backs. The 
traveller under the moon looked delighted 
at the thought of the festival of races to 
come ——
